title: 채널별 성과 · 집계 테이블
sql:
SELECT report_date, channel, visits, page_views, orders, revenue_krw
FROM mvp_history_daily
WHERE report_date BETWEEN %(start_date)s AND %(end_date)s
ORDER BY report_date, channel

title: 디바이스별 성과 · 원본 테이블
sql:
SELECT report_date, device, SUM(visits) AS visits, SUM(orders) AS orders, SUM(revenue_krw) AS revenue_krw
FROM mvp_raw_daily
WHERE report_date BETWEEN %(start_date)s AND %(end_date)s
GROUP BY report_date, device
ORDER BY report_date, device
